market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Iran conflict sustains oil premium and inflation fears. Fed rate-hike bets pressure equities, gold, and crypto. Bond yields remain elevated. Broadcom Sep 2 earnings is key catalyst. September seasonality historically weak for tech. Expect volatility 15-20% range in equities.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle (data centers, GPU contracts) supports multi-year earnings growth. China stabilization and foreign inflows offer EM upside. However, sovereign debt concerns (France, Pakistan) and sticky inflation cap multiple expansion. Energy transition reshapes commodity landscape. Consumer spending normalization likely by Q1 2027.
